description: Use this when an adult asks whether their waist or belly size is too big or risky, such as "is 36 inch waist bad for a man", "waist 88 cm woman", "waist to height ratio 92 cm 170 cm" or "belly fat cutoff for Indians". Do not use for children, pregnancy, diagnosis of a disease, or treatment and medication questions.

height_ft.description: Height feet part, if not using centimetres

height_in.description: Height inches part, used with height_ft

waist_cm.description: Waist in centimetres, measured at the belly button after breathing out

waist_in.description: Waist in inches, if not using centimetres

name: waist_check
title: Waist size check
